title: The Government Just Intervened in AI Stocks!
speaker: Ricky Gutierrez

macro_themes.view: Trump says the US may take stakes in OpenAI, Anthropic and other AI firms, which sparked a rally in MU and AI names.
China suspending fuel exports is huge for diesel, already at all-time highs, and will hurt inflation numbers.
Anthropic may IPO before Thanksgiving at ~$2T; worth trading for momentum, not investing at the hype price.

notes: Date: 'happy Thursday' and Micron reported 'yesterday', so Thursday 2026-10-01 (listing approx Oct 2). No directional calls: MU traded both ways intraday; Intel stake question asked without a view.
